mapper.select: SELECT id, assignment_id, student_id, submission_no, content_text, submitted_at, is_late, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM submissions WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, assignment_id, student_id, submission_no, content_text, submitted_at, is_late, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM submissions WHERE id = #{id} AND assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, assignment_id, student_id, submission_no, content_text, submitted_at, is_late, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY submission_no ASC

SELECT id, assignment_id, student_id, submission_no, content_text, submitted_at, is_late, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY student_id ASC, submission_no ASC

SELECT id, assignment_id, student_id, submission_no, content_text, submitted_at, is_late, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submissions ( assignment_id, student_id, submission_no, content_text, submitted_at, is_late, status ) VALUES ( #{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{submissionNo}, #{contentText}, #{submittedAt}, #{isLate}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE submissions SET content_text = #{contentText}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, is_late = #{isLate}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE submissions SET content_text = #{contentText}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
